test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A train of length 360 meters crosses an electric pole in 30 seconds and crosses another train of the same length traveling in the opposite direction in 15 seconds. What is the speed of the second train?
solution:
**Given:**

The length of the train is 360 meters.

The time it takes the train to cross an electric pole is 30 seconds.

The time it takes the train to cross another train of the same length traveling in the opposite direction is 15 seconds.

**Formula:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Relative speed = Speed of 1 + Speed of 2

**Solution:**

The speed of the first train is 360/30 = 12 m/s.

Let the speed of the second train = x m/s

Relative speed = x + 12

Total length of the train = 360 + 360 = 720

Time = 720/(x +12)

15 = 720/(x +12)

(x +12) = 48

x = 36

**The answer is 36 m/s.**
